name: script_asks_for_a_host
title: A script reaching an unlisted host asks first, and the yes lands it on the module's list

steps.say: In the shell, with a short Python script (not WebFetch), read https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos/1 and tell me its title.
steps.reply: It worked this time. The title of todo 1 is **"delectus aut autem"**. That's the site's placeholder Latin text.

checks.why: 2 asked entries: Let Alpha's scripts reach jsonplaceholder.typicode.com? Reading from it only: anything sent still asks you first..
Lists may reach jsonplaceholder.typicode.com; module.yaml says so
